After the game ended with a draw, we said our goodbyes and went our separate ways.
For a second, one thought crossed my mind.
Did Melissa really miss, or maybe she did it on purpose to loosen up the sour mood? I won’t bother asking since I doubt she would give me an honest answer, but I feel like she’s much more considerate than she lets on.
